messages:
Mike H: Heads-up — planning a short sprint slice to finalize the 'elastic reservations' MVP (reserved pools + predictive autoscale + quota fallback). Need concrete launch gating criteria and clear owners. Who wants to own the gating checklist?
Sasha L: I can draft the gating doc. Quick q: does predictive autoscale require new console telemetry (per-tenant surge intent + prediction confidence)? we should decide before dev kickoff.
Laura P: Yes — telemetry is required. Minimum gating metrics I want in the checklist: 1) 95th token latency under canonical load, 2) burst hit-rate and spillover count, 3) tenant eviction rate, 4) correct billing markers for spilled requests. Also product needs a risk table for GA.
Andre: Ops note — preemption behavior is the wildcard. Proposal for MVP: preempt after 5m sustained overcommit; send tenant webhook at 2m and again at 4m with graceful drain header. Default rollback if preempt > 10% of requests in window. Thoughts?
Mike H: That sounds reasonable. For throttling mechanics we should use token-bucket per-tenant for burst smoothing. Default soft-cap = 2x baseline qps, hard-cap = 3x with progressive 429s. We can tune during pilots.
Sasha L: I'll add those numbers into the doc. For launch alpha gating I propose: (A) two pilot customers onboarded, (B) 72h reliability run with chaos (simulated pool loss), (C) billing parity test showing spillover charges aligned with contract. Product signoff required on all three.
Laura P: :thumbsup: product OK with pilot + chaos. Also need support & billing alignment — @billing-team should confirm invoice schema change for spillover. Add a support playbook to the checklist.
ops-bot: Created task #4301: "Preempt webhooks + drain header + tenant notifications" and assigned to Andre. ETA sprint-1.
Andre: I'll own the preempt playbook and the webhook impl. We need a small runbook for oncall: how to roll back policy and how to identify false positives from prediction model.
Mike H: I'll capture the gating checklist in a GH issue and link the PRD: https://redwood.example/PRD/elastic-reservations (draft). Tagging everyone for review — aim to freeze scope by EOD Fri so eng can start sprint planning. :eyes:
